notes.title: 🎶【Free Update Event #6 】Maid on the Beat
notes.content: [p]With this update, CyberMaid will automatically dance and sway to the rhythm of your in-game music. Whether it’s a cheerful melody or a steady beat, she’ll move in sync—adding more companionship and immersion to your desktop.[/p][p]This is just the first step toward richer interactions, with more reactions and exclusive moves planned for future updates. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Free Update #5 Released｜"Always on Top" Mode + BGM & Mute Function Added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549502/683a945b8319ab0cd4b67d7729826d471af9bccf.png[/img]

🎉 New Features in This Update:

🔝 Always on Top: Keep your companion floating on screen at all times — perfect for multitasking!

🎵 Background Music: Add some cute atmosphere with new BGM tracks.

🔇 Volume & Mute Toggle: Not in the mood for sound? One click and it’s all quiet.

✨ Thanks for your support — we’ll keep improving the experience step by step!

notes.title: Free Update #4 - Interaction Upgrade! Her face says it all ♥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549502/cd318f70f8c113063da7da952f92f3512c58e420.png[/img]

In this update, we've enhanced the character's sensory feedback system. She now reacts more naturally to your interactions—with facial expressions ranging from surprise and shyness to visible enjoyment and comfort.

This is more than just a technical upgrade—it's a step closer to making your virtual companion feel truly alive. From subtle eye tracking and gentle body movements, to that slight smile when you touch her—every detail has been tuned to make the experience more personal.

Let her reactions guide you—she definitely feels something now.

notes.title: Free Update 3#!! She Turns Now. Desktop Maid Major Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549502/31ba5d40fb51110312e5a16d7fdf0facb24af854.gif[/img]
💫 She Doesn’t Just Look At You Anymore. Now She Turns.
You thought she was just a cute static decoration on your desktop?
Think again. She can turn now.

🔄 New Feature: 360° Free View Mode
Hold your middle mouse button and drag — watch your maid spin smoothly:

Front view: sweet smile.

Back view: secret blush.

Side view: intense eye contact.

Top view: you... little gremlin. (Yes, we see you.)

notes.title: FREE Update 2 New voice update! Tap her (gently...) to hear some ahem reactions.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549502/a5de311baf5bc68ba6b5d04696b8f021994eee00.png[/img]

🎉 Update Highlights:

✨ Voice Reaction System added

👈 Touch her in the right spots and enjoy her “feedback”

💕 A variety of moans, gasps, and flustered responses

🛠 General polish and improvements

🆓 Absolutely FREE for existing owners.
No extra charge. No gacha. Just touch, and enjoy 😌

🛒 Still watching from the sidelines?
She’s cute. She’s loyal.
And now… she talks back.
Make her yours today, Master ♥

---

We’ll continue bringing more refinements and small feature updates  
to make **CyberMaid** an even more delightful part of your daily experience.

All future updates will be **free** for players who already own the game —  
thank you so much for your continued support and companionship!

The price **may be adjusted** in the future if major content expansions are added.

If you’ve already felt a little spark with her,  
maybe it’s time to bring her home. 💗

notes.title: 💞 Free Update｜Character Interaction Enhanced: She’ll blush when you touch her!
notes.content:
# 💞 New Interaction Update: Blushing System Activated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549502/cda9f50aab2e906448bf917b44a1f26553d305ab.gif[/img]

Dear Master,

We’ve enhanced character touch interactions!  
Starting from this update, characters will now show **blushing facial expressions** in certain situations—making every touch feel more real and emotionally connected 💗

# (〃ﾟ3ﾟ〃) I-I might blush if you touch me like that…

Master... from today on…  
If you touch me there... I-I’ll get a little embarrassed, okay!?

---

## 🆕 Update Highlights:

- When the character’s chest is touched, a blushing effect will now appear on her face
- Expressions dynamically change based on intensity and angle of the interaction
- More emotional reactions coming soon—stay tuned!

---

It’s a little surprise, and a step closer to making her feel more like someone real.  
She might not say it out loud… but trust us—she’s totally blushing (*ﾉ∀`*)

---

Thank you as always for your continued support.  
CyberMaid will keep enhancing emotional interaction systems to become the most caring and responsive maid just for you ❤️

notes.title: Dev Update: We’re Moving! (And so is she)
notes.content:
📢 Dev Update: We’re Moving! (And so is she)
🛠️ We’ve been working hard — no slacking here! (Well, you get to slack off with her.)

With launch getting closer, we’re fine-tuning every detail so your desktop companion feels just right.
Not just cute — clingy in the best way possible.

🔹 What’s new:

🖱️ Smoother touch animations — the only interaction point for now, but hey, we made it count.

💻 Cleaner interface — easy enough that you’ll almost forget it’s an 18+ game.
(She stays quiet in the corner... unless you poke her.)

🐛 Visual bugs fixed. No more sudden jumps across the screen.
(Probably. She has her own opinions.)

This isn’t just a lewd game — it’s a naughty little form of comfort.
Cute, clingy, and just slightly too interested in your workday.

✨ Add to your wishlist now, and she’ll be one step closer to your desktop.
